sn_aia_tool.description: Orchestrates download, install, and upgrade of plugin packages in the selected priority order. Processes one plugin at a time and reports individual status.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"plugin_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the plugin to upgrade","mandatory":true},{"name":"plugin_name","description":"Display name of the plugin being upgraded","mandatory":true},{"name":"target_version","description":"Target version to upgrade to","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Perform Plugin Upgrade
